stem: After an A/B test ends, an analyst tries caps of €200, €500 and €1,000 on basket value, and reports the €500 cap because only that one makes the treatment significant. What is wrong with this?

options.text: Nothing, as long as the same cap is used for both groups
The cap was picked for the result it gives, which biases the test
A cap may only be applied to the control group, never to the treatment
€500 is too high: a cap must sit below the median basket
